acceptance_criteria.statement: One focused synchronous loader and stable error type handle all CLI pack and instance JSON reads without raw stack traces.
Only non-empty project-relative paths resolving lexically and by realpath inside the real project root are accepted; absolute, traversal, final-symlink, and ancestor-symlink escapes fail closed.
The loader opens and reads only a regular file, enforces a 1 MiB bound, uses fatal UTF-8 decoding, parses JSON, and accepts only plain-object roots.
Loader failures expose stable controlled codes and non-secret messages; the CLI emits one controlled line with exit code 2 while preserving PolicyError handling.
The implementation uses Node 22 built-ins and minimizes path-swap exposure without making an unsupported complete-TOCTOU-safety claim.
Deterministic temporary-directory tests cover valid input and every required negative class, CLI formatting/import behavior, stable codes, and message non-disclosure with cleanup.
Exactly the three allowed files change; npm test and git diff --check pass without dependency, network, transfer, commit, or external changes.
